entities.summary: "Somethin' Else" is a song by the rockabilly musician Eddie Cochran, co-written by his girlfriend Sharon Sheeley and his elder brother Bob Cochran, and released in 1959. It has been covered by a wide range of artists, including Johnny Hallyday, the Sex Pistols, Led Zeppelin, and Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers.
